optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Supply Chain Collaboration
professionalSummary: Experienced project manager with a proven track record of reducing supplier onboarding times by 37% through systematic milestone planning and integration coordination.
Expertise in maintaining comprehensive programme trackers, facilitating weekly reviews, and documenting hand‑over conditions for seamless support transition.
experienceHighlights: Planned onboarding projects for 23 suppliers across two manufacturers, maintaining detailed milestone schedules in the programme tracker.
Tracked integration milestones with three engineers, updating weekly status and driving recovery actions.
Reduced average onboarding time from 46 to 29 days for 17 suppliers after implementing standard mapping templates.
Coordinated onboarding decisions with programme lead and customer operations, ensuring clear responsibility boundaries.
Authored completion notes detailing limitations and hand‑over points for each supplier.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Programme tracker export showing onboarding days per supplier, baseline line, and template introduction marker.
Supplier completion note illustrating documented limitations and hand‑over conditions.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s experience in planning and tracking supplier onboarding projects, reducing onboarding time, coordinating with programme leads and customer operations, and documenting hand‑over conditions. They do not provide evidence of the candidate’s ability to travel to manufacturer sites or the length of notice period, nor do they confirm the candidate’s current employment status beyond the note.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate meets all listed requirements based on evidence; human review recommended to confirm current employment status and travel availability.

role.roleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Supply Chain Collaboration

evidence.text: Planned onboarding projects for twenty-three suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining the milestone schedule (connectivity test, mapping sign-off, parallel run, go-live) for each supplier in the programme tracker.

Work sample: the programme tracker export (onboarding days per supplier, baseline line, template introduction marker) and one supplier completion note, with the tracker's record identifiers as a verification trail.

Tracked integration milestones with the three integration engineers, updating supplier status in the tracker each week, raising slipped milestones in the weekly project review and agreeing recovery dates with the supplier contact and the engineer concerned.

Work sample: the programme tracker export (onboarding days per supplier, baseline line, template introduction marker) and one supplier completion note, with the tracker's record identifiers as a verification trail.

Average supplier onboarding time fell from 46 days to 29 days across the seventeen suppliers onboarded after the standard mapping templates were introduced, as recorded in the programme tracker against the recorded baseline of 46 days for the first six suppliers.

Reference call with former programme lead: confirmed the onboarding-day figures come from the programme tracker, that the standard mapping templates were introduced by the candidate, and the employment dates.
Coordinated onboarding decisions with the programme lead and customer operations; the programme lead decided supplier sequencing and customer operations confirmed each go-live with the manufacturer.

Work sample: the programme tracker export (onboarding days per supplier, baseline line, template introduction marker) and one supplier completion note, with the tracker's record identifiers as a verification trail.
Wrote the completion note for each onboarded supplier, listing open mapping limitations and the hand-over points for the support team.

Work sample: the programme tracker export (onboarding days per supplier, baseline line, template introduction marker) and one supplier completion note, with the tracker's record identifiers as a verification trail.

supportedClaims.claim: Candidate reduced average supplier onboarding time from 46 to 29 days for 17 suppliers.
supportedClaims.witness: Average supplier onboarding time fell from 46 days to 29 days across the seventeen suppliers onboarded after the standard mapping templates were introduced, as recorded in the programme tracker against the recorded baseline of 46 days for the first six suppliers.

followUpQuestions.question: Can you describe a specific instance where you had to adjust onboarding decisions due to a change in customer operations requirements?
followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Detailed example of decision coordination and boundary clarification.

followUpQuestions.question: How did you prioritize milestones across multiple suppliers with overlapping schedules?

Verify that the programme tracker export is accessible and matches the described metrics.
Ensure that the candidate’s role involved direct coordination with programme lead and customer operations as stated.
